name: NL Scholarship at The Hague University of Applied Sciences
provider: The Hague University of Applied Sciences (THUAS), financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science

summary.fr: Bourse de 5 000 EUR (NL Scholarship) pour les étudiants hors Espace économique européen et hors Suisse qui entrent en licence à La Haye.
summary.en: EUR 5,000 NL Scholarship for students from outside the EEA and Switzerland starting a bachelor’s at The Hague University of Applied Sciences.

howToApply.fr: Postulez à votre programme à THUAS, puis soumettez l'essai demandé avant la date limite.
howToApply.en: Apply to your programme at THUAS, then submit the required essay before the deadline.

eligibility.quote: Do you come from outside the EEA (EU countries, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway) or Switzerland and want to do your bachelors degree at THUAS?

level.quote: are applying for a full-time bachelors or masters program

support.quote: The scholarship amounts to € 5,000. You will receive this in the first year of your studies.

howToApply.quote: Please submit your essay before May 1st, 2026.
